report.title: Report
report.invalid: There is nothing to report from this link.

about.post: Moderators will see the post and decide what to do.
about.person: Moderators will look at this account.
about.inviter: The person who invited them stays hidden from you. Moderators can see who it is and look at the invites they made.
about.preview: Use this when a link preview shows something different from where the link really goes.

report.anonymous: Only moderators see reports. Nobody is told who reported.
report.sent: Thank you. Moderators will look at it.

reasonHint.bot: Posts or likes that a program sends instead of a person.
reasonHint.impersonation: Using someone else's name or identity.
reasonHint.misleading_preview: The preview does not match the page the link opens.
reasonHint.csam: Moderators handle these first and never show the content to anyone.

blame.title: Blame inbox
blame.intro: When a moderator confirms action against someone you invited, it shows up here. Who reported it is never shown.
blame.empty: Nothing here. Nobody you invited has had a moderator act on them.
blame.item: {action, select, remove_post {A moderator removed a post by @{handle}, whom you invited.} suspend_user {A moderator suspended @{handle}, whom you invited.} other {A moderator took action on @{handle}, whom you invited.}}
blame.post: The post by @{handle}, as you saw it:

queue.title: Moderation queue
queue.membersOnly: Only moderators can see this page.
queue.intro: Open reports, most urgent first. Suspending an account needs a second moderator within 24 hours.
queue.subject: About @{handle}
queue.inviter: {kind, select, genesis {(genesis account)} deleted {(invited by a deleted account)} other {(invited by @{handle})}}
queue.noContent: The content is never shown for this reason.
queue.awaiting: Waiting for a second moderator to confirm the suspension.
queue.twoPerson: A second moderator has to confirm this.
queue.started: Sent. A second moderator has to confirm it within 24 hours.

log.title: Moderation log
log.intro: Every confirmed removal and suspension, by day. People you are connected to are named; everyone else has a stand-in name.
log.subject: Who
log.pseudonymHint: Someone outside your network. The same account always has the same stand-in name.

errors.action_invalid: That action does not fit this report.
errors.action_pending: A suspension is already waiting for a second moderator.
errors.no_subject: There is no account to act on.
errors.second_moderator_required: A different moderator has to confirm this.
errors.action_expired: The 24 hours ran out. Start again.
errors.subject_inactive: This account is already suspended or deleted.
